title: Air-fryer chicken fajitas
subtitle: Sliced chicken and peppers cooked in the air fryer for a quick fajita night.
excerpt: Sliced chicken thighs and peppers seasoned with fajita spices and air-fried together until slightly charred and juicy. Served in warm tortillas with toppings. Serves four.
sourceNotes: Fajitas are a Tex-Mex dish of grilled meat served with sautéed peppers and onions in flour tortillas, originating in the ranching culture of southern Texas and northern Mexico. They became extremely popular in British home cooking from the late 1990s.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Marinate the chicken up to 4 hours ahead in the fridge.

content.text: Chicken fajitas in the air fryer produce slightly charred chicken strips and tender peppers in 15 minutes. Slice the chicken thighs against the grain so the strips stay tender when cooked at high heat. The chicken and peppers go in together as they take the same amount of time.

items.prepNote: sliced into 1 cm strips across the grain
deseeded and cut into 1 cm strips

content.text: Combine {{chicken-thighs-boneless}} of sliced chicken strips, {{pepper-red}} of red pepper strips, and {{red-onion}} of onion wedges in a large bowl. Toss with {{olive-oil}} of oil, {{cumin-ground}} of cumin, {{paprika-smoked}} of smoked paprika, {{garlic-powder}} of garlic powder, {{chilli-powder}} of chilli powder, and {{sea-salt-fine}} of salt. Preheat the air fryer to 200°C. Spread in the basket ,  it is fine if slightly piled. Cook for 8 minutes, toss, and cook for a further 6-7 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the edges are charred.
Warm the {{tortilla-wrap}} tortillas in the microwave for 30 seconds wrapped in damp paper towel. Serve the chicken and peppers directly from the basket with the tortillas and toppings alongside.

items.cause: Overcooked, or sliced with the grain.
items.fix: Slice the chicken against the grain ,  the striation that runs along the thigh. Slicing with the grain makes longer muscle fibres that tighten and toughen.
Slice peppers to 1 cm maximum. Thicker strips need more time than the chicken.

items.symptom: Chicken pale and steamed, no char
items.cause: Basket too full or not enough preheat time.
items.fix: The basket can be mounded slightly but not overfull. Preheat fully at 200°C before adding the chicken.

content.text: Air-fryer fajitas are a crowd-pleasing weeknight dinner. Set out soured cream, guacamole, grated cheddar, and sliced jalapeños for people to build their own. Leftover chicken and pepper filling works well in a quesadilla or over rice the next day.
